test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which fundamental right is violated if a group of people are NOT given permission to open a Telugu-medium school in Kerala?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cultural and Educational Rights**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Cultural and educational rights** would be violated if a group of people were denied permission to open a **Telugu medium school in Kerala**.
 
• According to the constitution, all religious and linguistic minorities have the right to establish their own educational institution in order to maintain and develop their culture.
 
• **Cultural and Educational Rights: **
 
 
• Fundamental rights protect citizens from the state's use of coercion and absolute authority. As a result, the Constitution protects individuals' rights both against the government and against other people.
 
• The Constitution says that all religious, linguistic, or minority groups have the freedom to establish their own educational institutions in order to maintain and develop their own culture. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The right to equalit**y guarantees that everyone is treated equally before the law, that discrimination on numerous grounds is prohibited, that everyone is treated equally in terms of public employment, and that untouchability and titles are abolished.
 
• "All persons have an equal** right to freedom** of conscience and the right to freely profess, practise, and spread religion subject to public order, morality, and health," according to Article 25.
 
• **The right to freedom **grants citizens basic freedoms such as freedom of speech and expression, the ability to form associations, personal liberty, and the ability to live a dignified life.
